title: GNPS_Zarrinpar_Anand_BSH_diet_mouse_fecal_QE
scientific_axis_considered: HFD_minus_NCD within vehicle, BSH-positive, and BSH-negative strata

metadata_topology.within_cluster_suffixes: one to four of N, L, R, B
metadata_topology.independence_status: unresolved: the deposit does not state whether suffixes are repeated samples from one mouse or mice nested within one cage; either interpretation forbids treating all files as independent randomized units

decision_reasons: Every BSH-by-diet cell contains only two repeated numeric clusters, so the effective subject or randomization-cluster denominator is at most two per cell.
The public metadata has no BioReplicate, cage, animal, or repeated-measure field that resolves the N/L/R/B suffixes.
The quantitative table contains only 35 of the 39 annotated biological files, so missing-file handling would also need a prospectively documented rule.
Treating the 35 file columns as independent mice would risk pseudoreplication and anti-conservative feature-level standard errors.
action: Do not build beta/SE response objects, do not register an HFD relation, and do not download the 2.3-GB raw/open-format archive unless an official animal-and-cage crosswalk is obtained.
leakage_status: metadata and deposited table schemas opened; no feature abundances, biological effects, response scores, or retrieval ranks evaluated
claim_boundary: This is a source-qualification failure, not evidence against HFD biology or the Metabolomic Contrast Atlas.
